# BoltProof
> BoltProof installs private AI systems for UAE businesses that work with a company's own documents, emails and repetitive admin — without routinely sending that data to a public AI service. The product is a configured private AI system (hardware, local models, document intelligence, workflow automation, security hardening, deployment, testing, staff access, backup options and ongoing support), not just a computer. Built on Apple Silicon hardware running Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n and Tailscale. Packages: AI Desk (Mac mini M5 Pro, 64 GB) from AED 16,500; AI Workhorse (Mac Studio M1 Ultra, 128 GB, certified pre-owned) from AED 20,000; AI Powerhouse (Mac Studio M5 Ultra, 512 GB) from AED 59,000. Backup & Redundancy add-on (Synology 2-bay NAS) from AED 4,500. BoltProof Care support AED 1,000/month, no tie-in. Contact: WhatsApp +971 58 510 9454. Set up on site in Dubai and the UAE; supported remotely worldwide.

## Facts
- Hardware: Apple Mac mini and Mac Studio, headless
- Software: Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, RAG document Q&A, Tailscale
- The AI runs on-site. Staff connect through a private encrypted network (Tailscale), with remote support available when configured
- External AI services are used only where a customer explicitly opts in and configures their own API key — not by default
- Prices in AED, exclusive of VAT
